name: COHORT_STATE_V1
membership: derive requested canonical calendar month boundaries in fixed America/Guayaquil and convert boundaries to UTC
select SRs whose accepted Report Date falls within that month and that have one current valid CPL classification compatible with resolved Customer
exclude Cancelled SRs from denominator entirely while retaining them in separate historical/excluded reporting population
require recognized severity and current accepted CPL policy; missing/unclassified/unusable inputs remain separate excluded/unresolved populations and never receive fabricated cohort membership
for each policy tier of the SR severity place the SR into the cohort key month + Customer + Contract + CPL + severity + policy_tier_id; outcome/state is not a key dimension
member_classification: calculate each member with INDIVIDUAL_SLA_V1 at the exact common as_of_utc
terminal_met contributes terminal_met_count and lower/best possible pass
terminal_exceeded contributes terminal_exceeded_count and cannot pass under current accepted evidence
active_within contributes active_within_count and remains best-possible pass but not lower-bound guaranteed pass
active_exceeded contributes active_exceeded_count and cannot meet the current tier under current accepted chronology absent a later governed correction/new suspension evidence
counts_and_exact_percentage: compare count percentage to required_percentage_millionths by integer cross multiplication: met_count * 100000000 >= required_percentage_millionths * denominator
never convert counts or configured percentage to binary float
state_matrix: if denominator=0, no canonical cohort result row is emitted; caller reports an empty/unresolved population separately
is_final = calendar month has ended before/as_of AND active_within_count=0 AND active_exceeded_count=0
if is_final and lower-bound comparison passes -> final_met
if best-possible comparison fails -> breached, whether month is open or closed
else if lower-bound comparison passes -> currently_met
an open/current month is never final_met because is_final is false while calendar month is not closed
rules: a closed calendar month with still-active cohort members remains non-final and uses pending/currently_met/at_risk/breached according to the same bounds
later accepted policy revision recalculates live cohort tier identities/results from that CPL's new current policy; completed report snapshots retain the old captured policy revision/tier results
later accepted terminal reversal or source correction recalculates the same surviving SR without creating a new SR episode
Objective timezone cannot move membership between months
